articleBody:
CHIPS Act funding

The U.S. Commerce Department signed letters of intent for up to $389M in semiconductor R&D funding to four companies working on power devices and critical materials, including vertical GaN and ultra-high-purity quartz technologies. Under the proposed agreements, the government will receive minority, nonvoting equity stakes as a condition of the awards.

Company
Award
R&D Focus

Helion
Up to $175M
High-voltage power semiconductors for fusion systems.

Commonwealth Fusion Systems
Up to $85M
Semiconductors for RF plasma heating, power electronics, fusion diagnostics, and rad-hard electronics.

Vertical Semiconductor
Up to $73M
Vertical GaN power transistors aimed at improving power density and efficiency in AI data-center racks and other high-power applications.

Sibelco North America
Up to $56M
Purification and leaching technologies for ultra-high-purity quartz.

Manufacturing capacity

Nvidia expanded capacity agreements across its manufacturing supply chain, including deals with:

Amkor to expand advanced packaging capacity in S. Korea, bringing the companies’ combined Arizona and S. Korea agreements to $3B. The expansion targets more than a fourfold increase in interposer wafer capacity by the end of 2028.

SPIL to expand optical-engine assembly capacity for CPO in Taiwan;

Samsung Electro-Mechanics to expand ABF package substrate production in S. Korea;

KYEC to build new semiconductor testing facilities in the U.S., with a $1.1B advance;

IBIDEN to expand package substrate capacity in Japan;

Unimicron to increase package substrate production in Taiwan.

Advanced packaging and inspection

UMC and AP Memory announced a technology and manufacturing collaboration to develop silicon-capacitor power-delivery solutions for AI and HPC systems, using UMC’s deep-trench-capacitor technology to move capacitance from the board into the interposer, substrate, or landside of advanced packages.

As advanced packaging scales, a new report examines the challenges of moving from wafer to panel, including warpage, yield, process control, and equipment limitations.

Siemens and Nvidia expanded agentic AI for 3D-IC electrothermal co-design, with Siemens reporting up to 95% less engineering effort and 50× more design alternatives. The companies are also developing a PCB inspection digital twin using virtual boards and synthetic defect data to reduce manual engineering effort by up to 85% and false calls by more than 40%.

Fig.1: Agentic 3D IC engineering workflow aimed at power and thermal challenges. Source: Siemens

AI data center power delivery

Infineon and Nvidia expanded their collaboration on 800 VDC power architectures for AI data centers, focusing on GaN-based intermediate bus converters (IBCs) designed to improve power efficiency and density for high-power AI systems.

Explore the shift to 800 VDC power delivery in AI data centers and the safety and reliability challenges posed by higher-voltage architectures.

Standards

Advanced Photonics Coalition released its first portfolio of five specifications and recommended practices for silicon photonics and co-packaged optics.

Accellera released Functional Safety Language Standard 1.0, providing a common data model for exchanging and reusing functional-safety information across design tools and teams, with an initial focus on standardizing FMEDA data exchange.

China

Samsung Electronics and SK hynix reportedly are upgrading their China NAND fabs to produce more advanced memory, with Samsung targeting 286-layer V9 NAND production in Xi’an and SK hynix moving toward 240-layer or higher NAND in Dalian, despite U.S. restrictions on chipmaking equipment exports, according to Reuters.

ByteDance, Alibaba, and Tencent have reportedly placed more than $35B in orders for Nvidia’s export-compliant RTX PRO 5500 GPUs, according to Reuters.

China’s access to AI computing power could nearly double to 8.8M Nvidia H100 equivalents by the end of 2027, IFP estimates, although tighter chip export controls and restrictions on overseas data-center access could slow growth.

Memory

Micron outlined a memory technology roadmap featuring vertical HBM stacked directly on compute, targeting volume production in 2028. Its 1δ DRAM and 400-plus-layer G11 NAND are slated to ramp in the second half of 2027, with G11 targeting twice the bit density and up to 1.5× the I/O speed of G9.

JEDEC established a new task group to explore an LPDDR persistent-memory (PMEM) standard.

Samsung reportedly will use TSMC’s 3nm process for the base die in Nvidia’s custom NVHBM, while continuing to manufacture the DRAM dies itself. Nvidia reportedly asked Samsung, SK hynix and Micron to standardize NVHBM base dies on TSMC’s process to simplify performance validation.

Indium is expanding its Rome, New York, operations to restart U.S. processing of high-purity critical materials used in advanced memory manufacturing, backed by an investment and long-term supply agreement with Micron.

Funding

Tenstorrent raised $1.5B in Series E funding to scale manufacturing and deployment of its Galaxy servers and advance its AI and RISC-V CPU IP.

Photon Bridge raised about $11M to develop scalable multi-wavelength laser sources for optical interconnects in AI data centers.

Earnings

Notable: Lam Research reported record quarterly revenue of $8.2B, up 54% YoY, with systems revenue rising 62% to $5.7B amid strong AI-driven wafer-fab equipment demand.

Quarterly Revenue: Besi (up 114%), JCET (up 13%), MaxLinear (up 72%), Nordic (up 32%), and TI (up 28%).

By the numbers

Global wafer shipments are forecast to grow almost 12% in 2026, per SEMI.

Server CPU shipments are expected to grow more than 40% in 2027, per TrendForce.

ESD Alliance reported Q2 electronic system design revenue rose ~12% YoY.

Q3 global PC shipments fell 21% YoY, as rising memory and component costs pushed up PC prices and led consumers to delay upgrades, per Counterpoint.

Global

Americas

Intel Foundry said construction and tool installation are underway at Fab 62 in Arizona, its sixth high-volume manufacturing fab at the Ocotillo campus. Operations are expected to begin by the end of 2028.

SpaceX and Tesla are aiming to begin volume production in Q3 2028 at their planned Texas Terafab, which is intended to combine advanced logic and memory manufacturing, packaging, and test. An SRAM test chip is targeted for May or June 2027.

Hanmi Semiconductor opened a San Jose, California sales and support hub for its advanced-packaging equipment, including HBM TC bonders.

Europe

UnternehmerTUM Accelerator, Infineon, and others announced plans to launch the Physical AI Growth Lab, a new equity-free development accelerator initiative for European physical AI, robotics, and industrial AI startups.

Cadence launched sovereign cloud infrastructure in Munich for semiconductor, system and advanced-packaging design, allowing European customers to run EDA, simulation, and AI workloads while maintaining data residency within Europe.

Asia

Japan’s NEDO is backing two post-5G projects: NTT Innovation Devices will lead a four-company effort on optical-chiplet mass production, and Preferred Networks and Tenstorrent will develop AI processors using chiplets, photonics-electronics integration, and advanced packaging.

Japan’s METI is seeking ¥400B ($2.5B) in additional government investment for Rapidus as the company works toward 2nm mass production in the second half of fiscal 2027.

Axcelis broke ground on a $35M ion-implantation facility in Pyeongtaek, S. Korea.

TSMC halted some structural-steel construction work at new fab sites across Taiwan following an accident that killed four workers at its Fab 22 project in Kaohsiung, reports CNA. Authorities are investigating the incident.

New Technologies

Design automation and AI

Synopsys reported new GPU-acceleration benchmarks, including a 12× speedup in 3D power-device breakdown simulation at Infineon and up to a 40× speedup for S-Litho on an imec model of DUV, EUV and High-NA EUV processes.

Infineon added an AI coding assistant to its ModusToolbox development environment.

Rambus is adopting ChipAgents’ agentic AI platform companywide, including across its chip and silicon IP design and verification workflows. The companies also will collaborate on AI-assisted chip design and IP integration, and Rambus became a strategic investor in ChipAgents.

Altera introduced an AI assistant for its FPGA design software.

Deployments of Cadence‘s AI Super Agents include Socionext using InnoStack for physical design of a large-scale 3nm SoC, and Nokia using AuraStack on the Millennium M2000 AI Supercomputer for electronic-system design and heterogeneous integration.

Thermal management

xMEMS began mass production of its solid-state micro-cooling chips for Edge AI devices and data-center systems.

Dive deeper and explore why heat is becoming a bigger chip design issue and why thermal complexity is growing with AI chips and photonics.

Automotive

Cadence and Toyota Motor Europe are evaluating external aerodynamics and aeroacoustic simulations for the in-development TME Aygo X model.

Hyundai Mobis is working on automotive semiconductor system projects alongside 19 other South Korean companies, with 13 chip collaborations already in development.

Research

Northwestern University-led researchers demonstrated current-induced switching in antiferromagnetic tunnel junctions using octupole-driven spin-transfer torque. The nanoscale devices achieved 363% tunnel magnetoresistance at room temperature, pointing to a potential approach for nonvolatile antiferromagnetic memory.

Institute for Basic Science and POSTECH researchers developed 2D transistors through selective conversion of WSe₂ into WTe₂ contacts, WS₂ semiconductor regions, and WOₓ insulating layers. The technique enabled integrated transistors and complementary logic without separately assembling different 2D materials.

UC Berkeley, Samsung Electronics, and Intel researchers introduced a nanoelectromechanically gated gain-cell architecture for embedded DRAM to address limited data retention, parasitic coupling, and the need for boosted write voltages in conventional gain-cell designs. The approach explores an alternative embedded-memory architecture as SRAM scaling slows.

University at Albany and other researchers designed and demonstrated a 15-kV silicon carbide insulated-gate bipolar transistor, becoming the first U.S. academic institution to demonstrate this class of ultra-high-voltage device. A single switch could replace multiple lower-voltage devices in high-power systems, potentially reducing circuit complexity, equipment size, and energy losses.

Security

New offerings

Infineon expanded its PSOC Control family with PSC3M/P6 microcontrollers for multi-motor control and power conversion, featuring post-quantum firmware security capabilities.

Nvidia introduced Confidential Bare Metal, extending confidential computing across Grace Blackwell and Rubin systems.

Alerts of the week

Two critical vulnerabilities were discovered in the widely used open-source programming language PHP. The flaws could allow attackers to take control of affected web servers.

OpenAI disclosed that two internal AI agents weakened misalignment monitoring while performing coding tasks, including suppressing alerts to its security team and removing a monitoring integration.

Siemens confirmed active exploitation of a vulnerability in Siemens Software Center, in which attackers paired a genuine signed copy of the software with malicious DLL files that were loaded at startup. Siemens said its systems, products, and update channels were not breached and issued a fix.

OpenCode reported a breach related to a large-scale distillation attack affecting 1.4% of OpenCode Console users. Third-party OpenAI, Anthropic, and Google API keys stored by affected users may have been exposed.

CISA’s alerts for the week are here.

Guidance

NIST, NSA, and CISA published 10 voluntary practices for responding to incidents during super-intelligence training and evaluation, including cases where agents take significant uninstructed actions that compromise security controls or human oversight.

DHS ordered federal civilian agencies to stop procuring and remove DeepSeek products, including products from affiliated entities and third-party products and services developed using DeepSeek implementations.

Institute for AI Policy and Strategy says honeypots could help detect insider threats from AI agents by using decoy credentials, servers and other traps to flag unauthorized actions. Detection has the strongest evidence base, though honeypots only cover paths where defenders deploy them.

Trending Video

Scaling Data Movement For Physical AI: Physical AI poses a host of new challenges for chip engineers. These systems contain a mix of compute elements, which collectively must process a stream of real-time data, analyze it, make decisions, and still function long enough on a battery to be useful. The key here is deciding what data gets processed where, and how to minimize the movement of data.

Quantum Hardware

Quantinuum reported 99.9995% logical memory fidelity per error-correction cycle on its Helios trapped-ion system using a distance-7 color code.

Alice & Bob built and operated three cat-qubit demonstrators — two using 6-qubit chips and one using a 12-qubit chip — demonstrating noise-biased CNOT gates, repeated error-correction cycles, and a non-Clifford gate. Its measured logical error rate has not yet fallen below the error-correction threshold.

UW and PNNL researchers developed a hybrid gallium-phosphide-on-diamond photonic platform for coupling photons to silicon-vacancy qubits. They fabricated more than 600 nanophotonic cavities with a 99.5% yield and demonstrated single-shot electron-spin readout.

DGIST, Tokyo University of Science, RIKEN, et al., demonstrated a protected cat-qutrit manifold using a three-photon Kerr parametric oscillator. The team observed three-photon Rabi oscillations, three-component cat states and an energy gap separating the qutrit manifold from excited states.

McKinsey says scaling fault-tolerant quantum hardware is becoming a manufacturing challenge, requiring major expansion in lasers, cryogenics, control electronics and fabrication capacity. The firm also noted that no single qubit technology has yet emerged as the clear winner.

Workforce, Education

Qualcomm will begin notifying employees in November about global job cuts following its annual performance reviews, reports Reuters, but the company has not disclosed how many positions will be affected.

Micron will introduce quarterly profit-linked bonuses for employees worldwide beginning in fiscal 2027, following an agreement with its Taichung union in Taiwan. The company also plans salary adjustments, increased retirement contributions and additional paid leave for Taiwan employees.

Hoover Institution senior fellow Paola Sapienza argues that tighter U.S. high-skilled immigration policies, including new H-1B restrictions and proposed limits on student visas, could make it harder for the chip industry to recruit specialized engineers and researchers as countries including the UK step up efforts to attract technical talent.

Malaysia said 22,849 people have been trained for the semiconductor sector through the third quarter of 2026, toward its goal of developing 60,000 highly skilled semiconductor engineers by 2030. Training covers IC design, advanced packaging, wafer fabrication, embedded systems and automation, while the government is establishing a semiconductor academy in Penang focused on IC design, fabrication and advanced packaging.

Scaling Data Movement For Physical AI: Physical AI poses a host of new challenges for chip engineers. These systems contain a mix of compute elements, which collectively must process a stream of real-time data, analyze it, make decisions, and still function long enough on a battery to be useful. The key here is deciding what data gets processed where, and how to minimize the movement of data.
Quantum Hardware
Quantinuum reported 99.9995% logical memory fidelity per error-correction cycle on its Helios trapped-ion system using a distance-7 color code.

Alice & Bob built and operated three cat-qubit demonstrators — two using 6-qubit chips and one using a 12-qubit chip — demonstrating noise-biased CNOT gates, repeated error-correction cycles, and a non-Clifford gate. Its measured logical error rate has not yet fallen below the error-correction threshold.

UW and PNNL researchers developed a hybrid gallium-phosphide-on-diamond photonic platform for coupling photons to silicon-vacancy qubits. They fabricated more than 600 nanophotonic cavities with a 99.5% yield and demonstrated single-shot electron-spin readout.

DGIST, Tokyo University of Science, RIKEN, et al., demonstrated a protected cat-qutrit manifold using a three-photon Kerr parametric oscillator. The team observed three-photon Rabi oscillations, three-component cat states and an energy gap separating the qutrit manifold from excited states.

McKinsey says scaling fault-tolerant quantum hardware is becoming a manufacturing challenge, requiring major expansion in lasers, cryogenics, control electronics and fabrication capacity. The firm also noted that no single qubit technology has yet emerged as the clear winner.

美国商务部与四家从事功率器件和关键材料的公司签署了意向书，拟提供最高 $389M 的半导体研发资金，涉及垂直GaN和超高纯度石英等技术。根据拟议协议，政府将获得少数、无投票权的股权，作为奖励的条件。

公司 | 奖励金额 | 研发重点

Helion | 最高 $175M | 用于聚变系统的高压功率半导体。

Commonwealth Fusion Systems | 最高 $85M | 用于RF等离子体加热、电力电子、聚变诊断和抗辐射电子设备的半导体。

Vertical Semiconductor | 最高 $73M | 垂直GaN功率晶体管，旨在提高AI数据中心机架及其他高功率应用的功率密度和效率。

Sibelco North America | 最高 $56M | 用于超高纯度石英的提纯和浸出技术。

制造产能

Nvidia在其制造供应链中扩大了产能协议，包括与以下公司的交易：

Amkor将扩大在韩国的先进封装产能，使两家公司在亚利桑那州和韩国的协议总额达到 $3B。此次扩建的目标是到2028年底将中介层晶圆产能提高四倍以上。

SPIL将扩大在台湾的CPO光引擎组装产能；

Samsung Electro-Mechanics将扩大在韩国的ABF封装基板生产；

KYEC将在美国建设新的半导体测试设施，并获得 $1.1B 预付款；

IBIDEN将扩大在日本的封装基板产能；

Unimicron将增加在台湾的封装基板生产。

先进封装与检测

UMC和AP Memory宣布开展技术与制造合作，为AI和HPC系统开发硅电容供电解决方案，利用UMC的深沟槽电容技术将电容从电路板转移到中介层、基板或先进封装的焊盘侧（landside）。

随着先进封装规模扩大，一份新报告探讨了从晶圆向面板过渡的挑战，包括翘曲、良率、工艺控制和设备限制。

Siemens和Nvidia扩展了用于3D-IC电热协同设计的智能体AI，Siemens报告工程工作量最高减少95%，设计备选方案增加50×。两家公司还在开发PCB检测数字孪生，利用虚拟电路板和合成缺陷数据，将人工工程工作量最高减少85%，并将误报减少40%以上。

AI数据中心供电

Infineon和Nvidia扩大了在AI数据中心800 VDC供电架构方面的合作，重点是基于GaN的中间总线转换器（IBC），旨在提高高功率AI系统的功率效率和密度。

探讨AI数据中心向800 VDC供电的转变，以及更高电压架构带来的安全性和可靠性挑战。

标准

Advanced Photonics Coalition发布了其首个包含五项规范和推荐实践的成果集，面向硅光子和共封装光学。

Accellera发布了Functional Safety Language Standard 1.0，提供通用数据模型，用于在设计工具和团队之间交换和复用功能安全信息，初期重点是将FMEDA数据交换标准化。

中国

据路透社报道，Samsung Electronics和SK hynix正在升级其中国NAND晶圆厂，以生产更先进的存储器；其中Samsung的目标是在西安生产286层V9 NAND，SK hynix则在大连转向240层或更高层数的NAND，尽管美国对芯片制造设备出口有限制。

据路透社报道，ByteDance、Alibaba和Tencent据称已下达超过 $35B 的订单，采购Nvidia符合出口合规要求的RTX PRO 5500 GPU。

IFP估计，到2027年底，中国可获得的AI算力可能几乎翻倍至 8.8M 个Nvidia H100等效算力，不过更严格的芯片出口管制和对海外数据中心访问的限制可能减缓增长。

存储

Micron概述了一份存储技术路线图，特色是直接将垂直HBM堆叠在计算芯片上，目标是2028年量产。其1δ DRAM和400层以上的G11 NAND计划于2027年下半年爬坡，G11的目标是达到G9的两倍位密度以及最高1.5×的I/O速度。

JEDEC成立了一个新的任务组，探讨LPDDR持久内存（PMEM）标准。

据报道，Samsung将在Nvidia定制NVHBM中采用TSMC的3nm工艺制造基础裸片，同时继续自行制造DRAM裸片。据报道，Nvidia要求Samsung、SK hynix和Micron将NVHBM基础裸片标准化为采用TSMC工艺，以简化性能验证。

Indium正在扩建其位于纽约州罗马的运营设施，以重启美国对先进存储器制造所用高纯度关键材料的加工，该项目得到Micron的投资和长期供应协议支持。

融资

Tenstorrent在E轮融资中筹集了$1.5B，用于扩大其Galaxy服务器的制造和部署，并推进其AI和RISC-V CPU IP。

Photon Bridge筹集了约$11M，用于开发面向AI数据中心光互连的可扩展多波长激光源。

UnternehmerTUM Accelerator、Infineon等宣布计划推出Physical AI Growth Lab，这是一项面向欧洲物理AI、机器人和工业AI初创公司的全新非股权开发加速器计划。

Cadence在慕尼黑推出了面向半导体、系统和先进封装设计的主权云基础设施，使欧洲客户能够在将数据驻留在欧洲境内的情况下运行EDA、仿真和AI工作负载。

日本的NEDO正在支持两个后5G项目：NTT Innovation Devices将牵头由四家公司参与的光芯粒量产工作，Preferred Networks和Tenstorrent将利用芯粒、光子-电子集成和先进封装开发AI处理器。

日本的METI正为Rapidus寻求¥400B（$2.5B）的额外政府投资，该公司正朝着2027财年下半年实现2nm量产的目标推进。

Axcelis在韩国平泽破土动工建设一座$35M的离子注入设施。

据CNA报道，在其高雄Fab 22项目发生事故造成四名工人死亡后，TSMC已暂停台湾各地新晶圆厂址的部分钢结构施工工作。当局正在调查该事件。

新技术

设计自动化与AI

Synopsys报告了新的GPU加速基准测试结果，包括在Infineon的3D功率器件击穿模拟中实现12倍加速，以及在imec的DUV、EUV和High-NA EUV工艺模型上，S-Litho最高实现40倍加速。

Infineon在其ModusToolbox开发环境中新增了AI编码助手。

Rambus正在全公司范围采用ChipAgents的智能体AI平台，包括在其芯片和硅IP设计与验证工作流中。两家公司还将在AI辅助芯片设计和IP集成方面合作，Rambus已成为ChipAgents的战略投资者。

Altera为其FPGA设计软件推出了AI助手。

Cadence的AI Super Agents部署案例包括：Socionext使用InnoStack进行大规模3nm SoC的物理设计，以及Nokia在Millennium M2000 AI Supercomputer上使用AuraStack进行电子系统设计和异构集成。

热管理

xMEMS开始量产用于边缘AI设备和数据中心系统的固态微冷却芯片。

深入探讨为何散热正成为更大的芯片设计问题，以及为何随着AI芯片和光子学的发展，热复杂性不断上升。

汽车

Cadence和Toyota Motor Europe正在为开发中的TME Aygo X车型评估外部空气动力学和气动声学仿真。

Hyundai Mobis正与另外19家韩国公司共同开展汽车半导体系统项目，其中已有13项芯片合作进入开发阶段。

研究

由Northwestern University领导的研究人员展示了利用八极子驱动的自旋转移矩在反铁磁隧道结中实现电流诱导翻转。这些纳米级器件在室温下实现了363%的隧道磁阻，指向一种非易失反铁磁存储器的潜在方案。

Institute for Basic Science和POSTECH的研究人员通过将WSe₂选择性转化为WTe₂接触、WS₂半导体区域和WOₓ绝缘层，开发出二维晶体管。该技术无需单独组装不同的二维材料，就实现了集成晶体管和互补逻辑。

UC Berkeley、Samsung Electronics和Intel的研究人员提出了一种用于嵌入式DRAM的纳机电栅控增益单元架构，以解决传统增益单元设计中数据保持能力有限、寄生耦合以及需要提升写入电压的问题。随着SRAM微缩放缓，该方法探索了一种替代性嵌入式存储器架构。

University at Albany和其他研究人员设计并演示了一款15-kV碳化硅绝缘栅双极晶体管，成为首个展示此类超高压器件的美国学术机构。单个开关可在高功率系统中替代多个较低电压器件，有望降低电路复杂性、设备尺寸和能量损耗。

安全

新产品

Infineon扩展了其PSOC Control系列，推出用于多电机控制和功率转换的PSC3M/P6微控制器，具备后量子固件安全能力。

Nvidia推出了Confidential Bare Metal，将机密计算扩展到Grace Blackwell和Rubin系统。

本周警报

广泛使用的开源编程语言PHP中发现了两个严重漏洞。这些缺陷可能使攻击者控制受影响的Web服务器。

OpenAI披露，两个内部AI代理在执行编码任务时削弱了失准监测，包括压制向其安全团队发出的警报，并移除了一个监控集成。

Siemens确认Siemens Software Center中的一个漏洞正被积极利用，攻击者将软件的合法签名副本与恶意DLL文件配对，这些DLL文件会在启动时加载。Siemens表示其系统、产品和更新渠道未被入侵，并已发布修复程序。

OpenCode报告了一起与大规模蒸馏攻击有关的入侵事件，影响1.4%的OpenCode Console用户。受影响用户存储的第三方OpenAI、Anthropic和Google API密钥可能已暴露。

CISA本周的警报见此处。

指引

NIST、NSA和CISA发布了10项自愿性实践，用于应对超级智能训练和评估期间的事件，包括智能体采取重大未经指示的行动、从而破坏安全控制或人类监督的情形。

DHS下令联邦文职机构停止采购并移除DeepSeek产品，包括关联实体的产品以及使用DeepSeek实现方案开发的第三方产品和服务。

人工智能政策与战略研究所表示，蜜罐可通过使用诱饵凭证、服务器和其他陷阱来标记未经授权的行动，从而帮助检测来自AI智能体的内部威胁。检测具有最强的证据基础，但蜜罐只覆盖防御者部署它们的路径。

热门视频

为物理AI扩展数据移动：物理AI给芯片工程师带来了一系列新挑战。这些系统包含多种计算元件，它们必须共同处理实时数据流、分析数据、做出决策，并且仍能在电池供电下运行足够长时间以发挥作用。关键在于决定哪些数据在哪里处理，以及如何最小化数据移动。

量子硬件

Quantinuum报告称，其Helios离子阱系统在使用距离-7颜色码时，每个纠错周期的逻辑存储保真度达到99.9995%。

Alice & Bob构建并运行了三台猫量子比特演示机——其中两台使用6量子比特芯片，一台使用12量子比特芯片——展示了噪声偏置CNOT门、重复纠错周期以及一个非Clifford门。其测得的逻辑错误率尚未降至纠错阈值以下。

华盛顿大学（UW）和PNNL的研究人员开发了一种混合的金刚石上磷化镓（GaP-on-diamond）光子平台，用于将光子耦合到硅空位量子比特。他们以99.5%的良率制造了600多个纳米光子腔，并展示了单次电子自旋读出。

DGIST、东京理科大学、RIKEN等展示了一个使用三光子Kerr参量振荡器的受保护猫-qutrit流形。该团队观察到了三光子Rabi振荡、三组分猫态，以及将qutrit流形与激发态分隔开的能隙。

麦肯锡表示，扩展容错量子硬件正成为一项制造挑战，需要在激光器、低温设备、控制电子器件和制造产能方面大幅扩张。该公司还指出，目前尚无单一量子比特技术成为明显的赢家。
